title: tasks/task-event@1 — officer_tasks outbox payload shape
description: Domain-local payload schema for the COG-1 tasks pilot (docs/plans/cognitive-core-phase-1-contract-2026-07-20.md §4.4, §5.2). Fields mirror the officer_tasks_outbox immutable content projection (§9.3): the domain columns the capture trigger snapshots, minus ids/timestamps, which ride the envelope. Status vocabulary is the EFFECTIVE-status dialect of §6.1: raw officer_tasks statuses (queue|wip|done|cancelled) plus the 'blocked' overlay surfaced as status, plus '' for the INSERT-arm empty old_status. Resolved by framework/triggers/schema_registry.py; this file NEVER feeds the central VALID_EVENT_TYPES enum (M4).

old_status.description: Effective status before the transition; null on the INSERT arm before mapping, '' after the §6.1 INSERT-arm mapping

new_status.description: Effective status after the transition (§6.1 mapping: blocked overlay surfaced as status)

old_blocked.description: Raw blocked flag before the transition; null on the INSERT arm

new_blocked.description: Raw blocked flag after the transition

blocked_reason.description: Reason recorded when the row entered blocked; travels in the payload (§9.3)

context_slug.description: officer_tasks.context_slug — domain payload, NEVER an org-scope level (§4.2: mapping contexts to lanes would be inference)
